input.summary: Complete the green, yellow, red, and blue drop-target banks to reach 5x bonus. When base bonus reaches 20,000 and lights the top saucer, use the upper mini-flippers to collect it; the collect resets base bonus but keeps the multiplier for the rest of the ball.

quickInfo.name: Green, yellow, red, and blue banks
quickInfo.summary: Complete green for 2x. Add yellow for 3x, red for 4x, and blue for 5x.

quickInfo.name: Completed-bank value
quickInfo.summary: After a color bank is completed once on a ball, each target in that bank scores 5,000 instead of 500.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: Drop targets build it. At 20,000, the top saucer lights to collect the current base bonus times the active multiplier.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus saucer
quickInfo.summary: A collect resets base bonus but leaves Bonus X intact. Prefer the collect at 4x or 5x.

quickInfo.name: Upper mini-flippers
quickInfo.summary: They provide the practical saucer shot and usually give a safer sideways angle into green and yellow targets.

steps.text: Complete the green drop targets to reach 2x bonus.
Complete yellow for 3x, then red for 4x.
Complete blue to reach 5x bonus.
Use the upper mini-flippers for green and yellow targets when their sideways angle is safer than a lower-flipper shot.
Continue drop-target hits until base bonus reaches 20,000 and lights the top saucer.
At 4x or 5x, use an upper mini-flipper, bank, or controlled nudge to send the ball into the top saucer.
After the collect resets base bonus, rebuild it while the multiplier remains active.

input.overview: Count-Down is a repeatable bonus-collect game built from the green, yellow, red, and blue banks, a 20,000 base bonus, and the top saucer. Complete all four banks for 5X, raise the base to its cap, and collect it with an upper mini-flipper. Keep hitting drop targets to raise the base again while 5X remains active for the rest of the ball.
